name: Dipal Panchal
player_statement:
A complete player, Dipal Panchal has made a big mark in cricket. With 19 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 37, with an average of 21.42 and a quick strike rate of 162.66. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 21 sixes and 14 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 28.0 overs, taking 16 wickets at an economy rate of 8.29. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
